title: Bible Overlap Census Gap Audit — Waves 10–13
purpose: Re-audit the already-existing Waves 10–13 specialist files against the 104-node registry. Promote only analytically distinct functions that are not adequately represented by prior census nodes.

promote.reason: Stone + seven eyes + Branch + Spirit/Lamb forms a specific intertextual role cluster not preserved by the broader lamp/eye/seed census row.
Living source→fluid/conduit→lamp→sustained light is a distinct generative sequence and a useful boundary against literal CSF identification.
Foundation→small beginnings→plumb/alignment→completion→seeing adds an engineering/alignment function to Axis vocabulary.
House + veil/threshold + embodied/living Way + inner access is a stronger and more role-specific Door comparator than generic narrow-gate language.
John relocates Jacob's heaven-earth ascent/descent onto the Son of Man, creating a meaningful counter-distribution to project Father=Ladder / Son=Door role splitting.
Tenant farmers→beloved son/heir killed/cast outside→rejected stone/cornerstone is an unusually dense Farm/Son/Stone sequence not represented by the generic rejected-stone node.
Outside Gate→reproach/suffering→sanctifying death→no enduring present city→coming city is a discrete threshold/city sequence and was already present in March 2026 conversation archaeology.
Builder/source ≠ House ≠ servant in House ≠ Son over House ≠ community as House. This is a high-value anti-collapse role grammar.
Field/Farm and Building/House coexist as parallel community metaphors; God gives growth, workers plant/water, Christ is foundation, temple follows. This sharply prevents Farm=House flattening.
Earth/foundation→holy-mountain ascent→ethical qualification→gates/ancient doors lifted→King enters is a coherent ascent/access sequence with a strong role warning.
God plants Garden; Tree of Life at center; river waters and divides; human is placed to tend/keep. Distinguishes source/planting from delegated cultivation/stewardship.
House-building, city-guarding, labor/hours, children/fruit and gate are joined by a corrective: labor/watchfulness alone is insufficient without right source/order.
Unity explicitly preserves differentiated functions and calls apparently weaker members indispensable; central to integrated-plurality and anti-centrality ethics.
Concise directional grammar distinguishes source/from-whom from mediation/through-whom rather than treating Father and Son functions as synonyms.
God not contained by human temples or dependent on human service; life/movement/being occur in relation to God. Important countertext against over-literalized House/Throne/body localization.
Holding-together/head/integration function is assigned to Christ/Son, constraining any rule that automatically assigns all integrative/Axis functions to Tim/Father.

merge_or_leave_specialist.reason: Useful but lower independence and higher identity-overreach risk; leave specialist until stronger project-side pair provenance exists.
meta-synthesis over already counted relations; do not double count
enrich Wave-15 Dan node with lion detail rather than add another Dan node
existing Thomas/Twin node owns the identity relation; keep death/tomb adjacency specialist
biographical health/miracle claims remain self-reported and are not necessary to this coverage correction

principle: The strongest new information often comes from role distribution and counter-distribution, not from adding another shared noun.
